# answerui

> Styles and browser behavior for semantic HTML, with FastHTML components

## Modules

- [answerui.behaviors](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/behaviors.html.md): Delegated event-handler runtime (`Registry.build_js`) and `browser.js` DOM hookup for AnswerUI's built-in interactions across htmx swaps.
- [answerui.controls](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/controls.html.md): FastHTML constructors for native buttons, inputs, groups, toolbars, copy actions, toggles, sliders, fields, and fieldsets styled from browser and ARIA states
- [answerui.data](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/data.html.md): Styled data tables (`table[table]`) and horizontally scrolling `DataTable` frames
- [answerui.demo](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/demo.html.md): Render FastHTML markup in isolated previews with current styles, behaviors, canned htmx routes, and reusable component examples
- [answerui.hdrs](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/hdrs.html.md): Inline or content-hashed page headers and footers for the registry's stylesheet, scripts, and icon spritesheet.
- [answerui.layout](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/layout.html.md): FastHTML constructors for stack, cluster, grid, and document flow layouts
- [answerui.navigation](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/navigation.html.md): Top-of-page navbar (`NavBar`) with a brand link, navigation links, actions, and an optional disclosure button for narrow screens
- [answerui.overlays](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/overlays.html.md): Popovers, menus, dialogs, drawers, and tooltips
- [answerui.registry](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/registry.html.md): Defining hyperelements and collecting their styles and behaviors
- `answerui.skill`: Build and customise FastHTML interfaces with AnswerUI's shared CSS, native HTML, utilities and browser behavior.
- [answerui.status](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/status.html.md): Feedback and loading states: alerts, toasts, progress bars, spinners and skeletons
- [answerui.surfaces](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/surfaces.html.md): Cards for grouping content, badges for short labels, and avatars for people and teams
